english: I hadn't left yet when she called.

czech: Ty jsi ještě neskončil, když začalo pršet.
english: You hadn't finished yet when it started raining.

czech: On ještě nejedl, když jsme dorazili.
english: He hadn't eaten yet when we arrived.

czech: Ona ještě nepřijela, když schůzka začala.
english: She hadn't arrived yet when the meeting started.

czech: To se ještě nerozbilo, když jsme to zkontrolovali.
english: It hadn't broken yet when we checked it.

czech: My jsme do té doby nezapomněli heslo.
english: We hadn't forgotten the password by then.

czech: Vy jste ten film neviděli, než jsme se setkali.
english: You hadn't seen the movie before we met.
